sections.h2: Three states hold 63.3% of implemented factory investment, 2021-2025

chart.title: Gujarat implemented more than Odisha and Maharashtra combined
chart.sub: Implemented industrial investment, 2021 to December 2025, Rs crore.
chart.source: DPIIT Industrial Entrepreneurs Memoranda, Part B.

sections.means: Gujarat, Odisha and Maharashtra took 63.3% of all implemented industrial investment in the five years to December 2025.
sections.todo: DPIIT should resume the monthly IEM Statistics Report, last issued for August 2024 data.

sections.h2: Karnataka has 2.2% of implemented investment and 22% of national FDI

chart.title: Karnataka's FDI is services and software, which IEM filings cannot see
chart.source: DPIIT IEM Part B; FDI equity inflow data.

sections.means: Karnataka is 2.2% of national implemented investment but 22% of national FDI.
sections.todo: DPIIT should add a field to IEM filings recording whether the capital is domestic or foreign.

sections.h2: Maharashtra has the most filed intent not yet built, Rs 454,589 crore

chart.title: Gujarat implemented more intent than it filed in the 2020-2025 window
chart.sub: Filed intent minus implemented investment, 2020-2025, Rs crore. Negative means more built than filed.
chart.source: DPIIT Part A and Part B, window-matched.

sections.means: Maharashtra has the largest unbuilt intent, while Gujarat built more than it filed in the window.
sections.todo: DPIIT should tag each Part B implementation with the year of its original Part A filing and publish conversion rates by filing cohort.
